title: flexEngineV2 engine configuration
$comment: EV-04 canonical form decision: the CANONICAL form is the one demo/edge/edge.example.yaml uses (also rendered by demo/lab/labinv.py and written by demo/sil/harness.py) because host.build() and core/reconciler.py consume exactly it and the plan's section 3.6 form is not a superset of it (it has no model/deployment, cloud.stackInfo, cloud.releaseKeyFiles, devices[].onboardingToken/safeStateFile/link, drivers.native as a bool, relay listen/mode/zenoh). The plan 3.6 form (apiVersion: flexengine/v2alpha1, cloud.releaseTrust, identity, local.http, observability -> logFormat/otel/historyMax, safeState, drivers.native {mode}, drivers.os-rauc) is converted to this form by flexengine2.config.load.from_plan_v2() (load() does it automatically when apiVersion or a plan-only top-level key is present). From the plan form the schema takes over mcu.smp {tty, baud} (d2-prep request R5, optional part: accepted by the schema, implemented later; the host still needs {host, port} today) and relay.model. ${VAR} references are expanded from the environment BEFORE validation; a reference to an unset variable is reported as an error. Paths are strings and are taken as given (relative = relative to the working directory). Unknown keys are errors at every level.

dataDir.description: Root of the engine state. Each device keeps `<dataDir>/<deviceId>/` (state.json, actions.jsonl, driver state, device.key) unless it sets its own `dataDir`.

model.description: flexModel workspace directory used by the MCU relay (types, rmw_zenoh keys). Required when a relay is enabled and does not set `relay.model`.

deployment.description: Deployment id in `model` the MCU relay maps (e.g. `d_pick_lab`). Required when a relay is enabled and does not set `relay.deployment`.

devices.description: The devices this host runs one engine each for (one host process, several device engines).

logFormat.description: Engine log format on stdout (journald): `json` = one JSON object per line (ts, level, device, event, dep, version, msg, ...), `text` = `<ts> [<device>] <msg>`. `$FLEX_LOG_FORMAT` applies when unset.

otel.description: Built-in OpenTelemetry spans (EV-09; needs the optional `otel` extra). `FLEX_OTEL=1`, `FLEX_OTEL_FILE` and `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` still work and also enable/configure it.

enabled.description: Emit engine.install / driver.apply / driver.remove / engine.health-gate / engine.rollback spans.

endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP collector base URL, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:4318` (`/v1/traces` is appended). Unset = `$OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, else no OTLP export.

file.description: Also write every finished span as one JSON line to this file.

historyMax.description: Transitions kept per device in the local status history (`<device dataDir>/history.jsonl`, rotated to `history.jsonl.1`).

shutdownGrace.description: Seconds a running apply / health gate may take to finish after SIGTERM before the host exits anyway.

local.description: Local operator API (CP-7, EV-07): HTTP over a Unix socket (every operation) and an optional read-only TCP bind with a bearer token (GET only). The CLI (`flexengine status|deployments|logs|history|bundle import`) uses the socket and falls back to reading the data directories when the engine is not running.

socket.description: Path of the API Unix socket (created mode 0660; its directory is created when missing). Default: /run/flexengine/api.sock when /run/flexengine exists (packaged service), else <dataDir>/api.sock.

group.description: Group that owns the socket (e.g. `flex`), so its members can use the API and the CLI. Unset = the engine's primary group.

tcp.description: Optional read-only TCP bind for the desk runbooks: GET operations only, each with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Unset = no TCP listener.

bind.description: `host:port` to listen on, e.g. `127.0.0.1:8781` (`[::1]:8781` for IPv6).

tokenFile.description: File holding the bearer token (mode 0600, owned by the engine user; read once at start).

enabled.description: Serve the local API while `flexengine run` runs (`--no-api` also turns it off).

b64key.description: Ed25519 public key, standard base64 of the 32 raw bytes.

pollInterval.description: Seconds between desired-state polls when nothing is in flight.

backoff.description: `[initial, maximum]` seconds of the exponential back-off while the cloud is unreachable.

httpTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds of one HTTP request to the cloud.

healthEveryTicks.description: Run the health check of installed deployments every N engine ticks.

safeStateFile.description: JSON file `{"machine_parked": bool, "operator_confirmed": bool}` with the safe-state signals that gate safety-relevant activations (FE-S6). Unset = no signal is ever true.

cloud.description: Connection to flexCloud and the trust anchors. Needs `apiUrl` or `stackInfo`, and `cloudPublicKey` or `stackInfo`.

apiUrl.description: Base URL of the flexCloud device API (CP-1), e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8700`. Taken from `stackInfo` when unset.

cloudPublicKey.description: Trust anchor for desired-state signatures (Ed25519, base64). Taken from `stackInfo` when unset.

stackInfo.description: demo/cloud's `stack.json`; fills `apiUrl` (its `internal.p2`, else `urls.p2`) and `cloudPublicKey` when they are unset.

releaseKeyFiles.description: Ed25519 release key files (`flex release` key format, base64 private key); their public keys are added to `releasePublicKeys`.

caFile.description: PEM file of the (lab) CA that an `https://` apiUrl must chain to; the only trusted CA (EV-06). Required for https unless `allowSystemTrust`.

tlsServerName.description: Host name checked in the cloud's TLS certificate instead of the apiUrl host (e.g. `cloud.lab` for an IP-addressed lab host).

allowSystemTrust.description: `true` lets an https apiUrl without `caFile` use the system trust store.

capsEveryTicks.description: Re-check the capabilities every N ticks and send them again when they changed (e.g. an executor that was unreachable at start answers now).

allowPlainHttp.description: `true` allows a plain `http://` apiUrl (lab and test only; refused otherwise). FLEX_ALLOW_PLAIN_HTTP=1 in the engine's environment has the same effect.

fixPermissions.description: Repair (chmod 0600 / 0700) a device key file or directory with group/other permissions instead of refusing to start.

outboxMax.description: Maximum status reports kept per device while the cloud is unreachable; beyond it superseded reports are dropped (newest per deployment kept) and a back-pressure warning is logged.

deviceId.description: Device id as registered in flexCloud (e.g. `panda`, `panda.portenta`, `unoq`). Unique per host.

role.description: Engine role reported in the capabilities. Default: `gateway` when another device names this one as `parent`, else `standalone-device`. Not allowed on an MCU child (always `child-device`).

parent.description: deviceId of the gateway an MCU child is attached to (see-thru mode). Only with `mcu`.

modelDevice.description: Device name of this device in the flexModel deployment (used by the MCU relay).

link.description: Free text describing the gateway-child link, reported in the gateway's capabilities (default `smp/uart`).

onboardingToken.description: One-time onboarding token (`POST /api/v1/admin/onboarding-tokens`). Only needed until the device is onboarded.

onboardingTokenFile.description: File holding the one-time onboarding token (mode 0600, owned by the engine user). The engine reads it at onboarding and overwrites + deletes it once the cloud confirmed; `onboardingToken` is the fallback when the file is absent.

drivers.description: Drivers of a (non-MCU) device; a device only gets the drivers it lists.

native.description: Native (container-free) driver. `true` = the process driver (plays systemd itself; tests and dev), an object selects the runtime: `{runtime: systemd}` writes real systemd units (EV-19).

runtime.description: `systemd`: workloads are unit files `flex-<deviceId>-<depId>.service` owned by systemd (they survive an engine restart and a reboot); `process`: the process driver (same as `native: true`).

scope.description: systemd: the system manager (engine runs as root, or as the flex user with the polkit rule packaging/polkit/50-flexengine-systemd.rules) or the user manager of the engine's user (`systemctl --user`, dev; enable lingering for boot).

unitDir.description: systemd: directory of the unit files (default /etc/systemd/system, user scope ~/.config/systemd/user); another directory is linked with `systemctl enable <path>`.

user.description: systemd, system scope: User= of the workload units (default: the engine's user; no User= line when the engine runs as root).

container.description: OCI container driver. `runtime: docker|podman` uses the CLI driver, `runtime: ankaios` the Ankaios driver.

runtime.description: Container executor (`quadlet` is planned, not in alpha).

allowedRunOptions.description: Allow-list of the `runOptions` a signed release may request; anything else fails the deployment (S4).

agent.description: Ankaios agent name workloads are placed on.

plcVerify.description: PLC interface verification (no download to the PLC): reads the running interface hash and holds/gates deployments on it.

plcs.description: PLC target (as in `flex-plc.json` `target` or the `plc` parameter, e.g. `panda/cx`, `opta`) -> connection.

cacheSeconds.description: How long a read interface hash is reused.

plcConnection.description: Connection to one PLC; `via` selects the form.

via.description: Transport: Beckhoff ADS, Modbus/TCP, or the shared-memory RT host of the SIL.

amsNetId.description: AMS Net ID of the PLC, e.g. `192.168.50.30.1.1`.

amsPort.description: AMS port of the PLC runtime (default from the release's flex-plc.json, else 851).

localNetId.description: Local AMS Net ID of the ADS client (needed on Linux).

instance.description: Bridge FB instance (the release's flex-plc.json `instance` wins).

port.description: Modbus/TCP port (default from the release's flex-plc.json, else 502).

path.description: Shared-memory region of the RT host (default `/dev/shm/<bridge>` of the release).

applab.description: Arduino App Lab driver (UNO Q) over `arduino-app-cli`, locally or over SSH (remote mode).

cli.description: `arduino-app-cli` binary (on the board in remote mode).

healthVia.description: Health source of the App: router RPC or app logs. Default `logs` when `ssh` is set.

takeoverForeignApps.description: Stop an App the engine did not start instead of failing.

keepReleases.description: Installed App releases kept for rollback.

cliTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds of one CLI call.

ssh.description: Remote mode: `user@host` of the board (the engine runs elsewhere).

remoteStaging.description: Staging directory on the board (remote mode).

mcu.description: Makes the device an MCU child (see-thru): mcu-module and mcu-firmware drivers over SMP (mcumgr). Needs `parent`; no `drivers`.

modulePublicKey.description: Raw P-256 public key (x||y, 64 bytes as hex) of the FLXM module signing key.

smp.description: SMP link: either `{host, port}` (TCP: QEMU or a serial-to-TCP bridge) or `{tty, baud}` (serial, accepted by the schema, implemented later: d2-prep request R5).

host.description: SMP-over-TCP host (QEMU serial socket or socat bridge).

smpSerial.title: serial form (accepted by schema, implemented later: R5)

tty.description: Serial device of the SMP UART, e.g. `/dev/ttyUSB0` (pyserial, no socat). Accepted by the schema, implemented later (R5).

baud.description: Baud rate of the SMP UART.

relay.description: MCU <-> Zenoh relay (rmw_zenoh keys of the MCU modules). Only on an MCU child.

maxRateHz.description: Sampling rate MCU -> Zenoh (capped at 10 Hz).

connect.description: Zenoh endpoint to connect to (zenohd / rmw_zenoh router). Unset or null = none.

listen.description: Zenoh endpoint to listen on. Unset or null = none.

zenoh.description: `false` runs the relay without a Zenoh session (tests).

modelDevice.description: Device name in the model (default: the device's `modelDevice`).

osRauc.description: RAUC whole-OS A/B driver (EV-17): `rauc install` into the other slot, reboot, health gate after the boot, `rauc status mark-good`. Needs rauc + rauc-service (D-Bus; packaging/polkit/50-flexengine-rauc.rules) and the engine data dir on the shared data partition.

conf.description: RAUC system.conf passed as `--conf` (default: RAUC's own, /etc/rauc/system.conf).

keyring.description: Keyring passed to `rauc info --keyring` in preflight (default: the system.conf keyring). `rauc install` always uses the keyring of the RAUC service.

rebootCommand.description: Command that reboots into the new slot after `rauc install`; the reboot ends the engine, which adopts the new slot at its next start.

sharedDataPath.description: Mount point of the data partition both slots share; the device's data dir must lie under it (else every os-rauc deployment is refused at preflight), so manifestVersion, the outbox and the driver state survive the slot switch.

bootTimeoutSeconds.description: How long apply waits for the requested reboot to end the engine; then the booted slot is made primary again and the deployment fails (rolled back).

cliTimeout.description: Timeout of the other rauc calls (status, info, mark-*) and of the reboot command.

bootIdFile.description: Source of the boot id that tells a reboot from an engine restart (tests: the boot simulator's file).

healthChecks.description: Device-side checks of the new OS after the boot: each command must exit 0 for the health gate to pass (in addition to: booted slot = target, not marked bad, and the release's http probe if it names a port).

arduinoOta.description: flexNode-arduino OTA driver (EV-38): serves the verified .ota image on the LAN under a one-time URL, sends the node a signed OTA_UPDATE command over MQTT and follows its flexCloud keys (status, version, ota, heartbeat) in Redis. Needs flexNode-arduino with the proposed remote-OTA command (flexengine/proposals/flexnode-arduino-remote-ota) and the Portenta OTA bootloader.

boards.description: Board name (the deployment parameter `board`; may be omitted when only one board is configured) -> node. One firmware per board: maxDeployments = number of boards.

mqtt.description: MQTT broker the nodes subscribe to (cm_MQTT_config of the sketches); per-board `mqtt` overrides it.

redis.description: flexCloud Redis the nodes write their keys to (flexCloud_config of the sketches); per-board `redis` overrides it.

acceptTimeoutSeconds.description: How long apply waits for the node to accept the OTA command (its `ota` key names the command id); then the update fails (offline node, wrong key, library without the remote OTA command).

updateTimeoutSeconds.description: How long apply waits for download, install and the restart into the new firmware; then the update fails (the board did not come back). Also the lifetime of the one-time download URL (+60 s).

pollSeconds.description: Interval at which apply reads the node's keys during an update.

timeout.description: Connect / reply timeout of one MQTT or Redis call, seconds.

healthyStatus.description: Status key values that count as healthy (with the expected version key and a live heartbeat).

failedStatus.description: Status key values of the installed firmware that fail the health gate at once (fail-fast).

requireHeartbeat.description: Require the node's heartbeat key (written by the patched library with a TTL) for running/healthy and before sending a command; false for nodes that do not write it (then a dead board keeps its last status).

fqbn.description: Board FQBN; the release layer's dev.flex.board must equal it and the .ota header must carry its magic.

connectorId.description: appDescriptor_config connector id of the sketch (prefix of its flexCloud keys and of the command topic flexcloud/<connectorId>/<applicationId>/cmd).

applicationId.description: appDescriptor_config application id of the sketch.

commandKeyFile.description: File with the node's flexCloud secret key (appDescriptor_config flexCloud_secret_key): hex, or the sketch's C array `0xae, 0xc1, ...`; signs the OTA_UPDATE command (HMAC-SHA256). Keep it readable by the engine only.

address.description: IP address of the board: when set, only this address may download its images.

redis.description: Per-board flexCloud Redis (merged over the driver's `redis`).

arduinoMqtt.description: MQTT broker connection (plain TCP, as the boards' PubSubClient).

arduinoRedis.description: flexCloud Redis connection (plain TCP, as the boards' Redis client).

db.description: Redis database of the flexCloud keys (flexCloud_config redis_db, e.g. 15).

arduinoServe.description: The driver's image server on the LAN: each image is offered once under /ota/<192-bit token>.ota, for updateTimeoutSeconds + 60 s.

port.description: Bind port (0: any free port, tests).

publicUrl.description: Base URL the boards download from (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8470; `{port}` is replaced by the bound port); required when host is 0.0.0.0.

certFile.description: TLS certificate (PEM) of the image server (https; the boards' Arduino_Portenta_OTA must trust its CA).

keyFile.description: TLS private key (PEM) of the image server.

allowPlainHttp.description: Lab flag (decision DA-4): serve over plain http when no certFile/keyFile is given; integrity still holds (the signed command carries the image's sha256), confidentiality of the firmware does not.
